banking-economy.title: India's payments authority NPCI forms unit to push into AI, blockchain tech
banking-economy.summary: The National Payments Corporation of India has created a technology subsidiary known as NPCI Tech Solutions Limited. This new unit will focus on advancements in AI, blockchain, and digital financial infrastructure. Vishal Kanvaty has been appointed as the managing director and CEO of the subsidiary.
